mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a one-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.5% over a one-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to lower corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns with a Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 98.0 for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 3.0%, the market prices in a high-conviction monetary tightening regime, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction (HOUST) above 530.0 thousand units, combined with a concurrent rise in real personal consumption (RSAFS), signals a recovery in private demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST > 530.0 and RSAFS > 350000.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in employment growth (PAYEMS) above 250k in a single month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals strong labor market momentum, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS > 250.0 and UNRATE < 10.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past five months, measured as a year-over-year contraction, indicates a weakening economy, which triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 shows a year-over-year decline (t-test p > 0.05).
